question.problem:
Suppose we wish to find a critical point of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[-1,2]\times [-2,1]⊆{R}^{2},$ where $$ f(x,y)=2x{y}^{2}-{x}^{2}y+3{x}^{2}. $$ Calculate the second iteration of the Newton-Raphson process for optimization that starts at ${x}_{0}=[2,\,-2]^{T}$ if the first iteration of the algorithm gives ${x}_{1}=[1.75,\,0.125]^{T}.$ Round your final answer to three decimal places (if needed).
${x}_{2}≈[$ $-0.301$ $]$
